### Signs and Wonders, Heresy, and Love for God
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/signs-and-wonders-heresy-and-love-for-god
Passage: Deuteronomy 13:1-3
Points:
- Supernatural signs and wonders can occur in the service of false teaching and heresy.
- Miracle-working abilities do not validate a teacher whose message leads people away from the true God.
- God sovereignly designs such encounters as a test of His people's loyalty.
- The testing reveals whether believers love God with all their heart and soul.
- Genuine, heartfelt love for God grants discernment to see through miraculous deception.

### The False Prophet
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/false-prophet
Passage: Deuteronomy 13:1-5
Points:
- Miraculous deeds alone were never sufficient in Israel to prove a prophet was from God.
- Any wonder-worker who enticed the covenant community toward idolatry faced capital punishment.
- False teachers claiming divine authority remain a primary danger under the new covenant.
- Christians are called to uphold apostolic orthodoxy and guard against the twisting of Scripture.
- Believers must lovingly and steadfastly confront doctrinal error rather than tolerating heresy.
